name: Pranav Joshi

footer: Thank you for reading. If something here resonates with you, I would love to hear from you.
intro: I am Pranav Joshi, and I study [Mathematics and Business Administration](yellow) at the University of Waterloo. I grew up believing that numbers tell stories, and I have spent the years since trying to listen carefully to what they say.

My work lives where three languages meet: the precision of [mathematical optimization](blue), the logic of [computer science](green), and the judgment of [business analysis](orange). I have shipped AI and automation systems into production, built agentic assistants that reason rather than merely reply, and watched tools I wrote quietly save companies thousands of dollars and hundreds of hours.

I am shaped as much by the competitions I have entered and the cases I have argued as by the contracts I have delivered. What moves me is curiosity, a stubborn love of mathematics, and the conviction that a well posed problem is already half solved. If any of this speaks to you, please reach out.

education.degree: Honours Bachelor of Mathematics, Mathematics/Business Administration, Co-op
